title: Answer: consciousness is experience, grounded in cosmic consciousness

statements.text: Phenomenal properties are ways of experiencing, distinguished by what it is like to have them, and a conscious subject is their bearer. Consciousness in creatures is a restricted, structured expression of a consciousness that pervades the cosmos.

sources.quote: I take phenomenal properties to be ways of experiencing, distinguished by what it’s like to have them.
with its modulation and restricted expression
